intro: Finding financial support for engineering studies in Kentucky can be a crucial step in your academic journey. This catalog features 5 scholarships specifically tailored for engineering students, with award sizes generally ranging from $1,000 to $3,000. Each listing has varying deadlines and requirements, so it's important to review the details closely to identify opportunities that align with your situation.
